chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 451: Gao Zhijian's Secret Military Path Power Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang struggles with his bizarre cultivation, discovers the Zuowandao's multi-generational plot, and is stunned by Gao Zhijian's sudden, brutal power from the Military Path.
og_description: Gao Zhijian reveals his hidden power! Plus, the Dice's centuries-long plot is laid bare.
twitter_title: DGYX Ch. 451: The Quiet Giant Gets Loud
twitter_description: Big news! Gao Zhijian went from mute muscle to secret weapon. Also, Li Huowang figures out the Zuowandao's ultimate scam.

lore_anchors.definition: The original, formless cosmic energy of creation in Daoist cosmology, existing before the division of Yin and Yang; a key component in advanced cultivation methods like the true cultivation method Li Huowang is learning.
A twisted expansion of the Buddhist concept of the Eight Sufferings, representing a granular spectrum of human emotional pain that the true cultivation method seeks to filter and transcend.

A classical xianxia cultivation branch focused on martial prowess, warfare, and building up tangible killing intent (煞气) to enhance strength; it values direct, brutal power over philosophical enlightenment.
A tangible aura of murderous will cultivated by practitioners of the Military Path; it can be used to intimidate, empower attacks, or even move objects.
A deified form of Laozi (Lao Tzu), the founder of Daoism; Danyangzi believed he received the heavenly scripture from this supreme Daoist deity, now revealed as a Zuowandao plot.
